creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-10-13 on 0.15.0 during a parallel-work round. Two posts to a busy Claude Code worker (#13, then #14 with --urgent) never reached its running turn; an earlier urgent post (#9) to the same worker had been typed in mid-turn as documented. The worker found them only when its own `msg post` was refused for unread messages. The urgent notice for #13-14 had been typed into the prompt box and left there unsubmitted until the turn ended. The integrator then ran `muster pane send --pane

"/clear" --confirm` and a Return, and Claude Code submitted the box as one prompt: "... muster msg read --group muster-2+muster-integrator/clear". So `/clear` ran as text, the context was not cleared, and `--confirm` passed because the text did appear. Two things to look at: why an urgent notice typed mid-turn stayed unsubmitted (the worker's turn was long cargo test runs; the earlier urgent one went through), and whether `pane send` should refuse, or say so, when the prompt it types into is not empty. Card a_2hIfvZQJP (`--confirm` passed but text never reached a busy Claude pane) is nearby.
title: An urgent notice typed into a busy Claude pane can sit unsent, and a later pane send is appended to it
